import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import { useSocket } from '../context/SocketContext'; function LandingPage() { const navigate = useNavigate(); const { socket, connected } = useSocket(); const [playerName, setPlayerName] = useState(''); const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false); const [showJoin, setShowJoin] = useState(false); const [joinCode, setJoinCode] = useState(''); const handleCreateGame = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!playerName.trim()) return; localStorage.setItem('playerName', playerName.trim()); navigate('/create'); }; const handleJoinGame = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!playerName.trim() || !joinCode.trim()) return; localStorage.setItem('playerName', playerName.trim()); navigate(`/join/${joinCode.trim().toUpperCase()}`); }; return (

London, 1895. A series of baffling mysteries plague the fog-laden streets of Victorian London. Scotland Yard is stumped. They need minds sharper than their own—minds that think as one.

You and your partner. Separated by distance, united by deduction. Examine evidence, interrogate suspects, piece together clues in real-time. Every case a test of your partnership. Every solution, a triumph of two minds in harmony.
